# Validate inputs
    counts = np.asarray(counts)
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all() or np.any(counts < 0):
        raise ValueError("Input must be finite and nonnegative")
    if np.any(np.all(counts == 0, axis=1)):
        raise ValueError("All-zero cell rows are not allowed")
    n_cells = counts.shape[0]
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be between 1 and n_cells-1")
    # Row L2 normalization
    row_norms = np.linalg.norm(counts, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    X_norm = counts / row_norms
    # Matrix-free operator for W = X_norm @ X_norm^T
    from scipy.sparse.linalg import eigsh, LinearOperator
    def matvec(x):
        return X_norm @ (X_norm.T @ x)
    W_op = LinearOperator((n_cells, n_cells), matvec=matvec, dtype=np.float64)
    # Compute leading eigenvalues and eigenvectors
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    v0 = rng.randn(n_cells)
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(W_op, k=n_components, which='LM',
                                     v0=v0)
    # eigsh returns ascending order; reverse to descending
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[::-1]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, ::-1]
    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors
